note: Football Manager 27 launch day, banked for 10 Nov. Source: Steam Gameplay trailer, 1920x1080 at 5.5 Mbps (above the 5 Mbps floor), decode clean, cropped to 9:16 at 1.78x (under the 2x cap). The trailer is narrated by Sports Interactive staff for all 232 s and carries burnt-in English subtitles at 88 to 96% of the frame height and a DEVELOPMENT BUILD watermark: shots were chosen where the subtitle line fits whole inside the 608 px window (x 656 to 1264), so no subtitle is cut mid-line, and the strip and lines sit above it. Sound: our bed, reason: narration under every second of both Steam trailers (Gameplay and Tactic Training), no music-only stretch. v3 (10 Nov, director fixes): line 1 second shot replaced by the 124.0 s stretch, line 3 moved to 56.0 s, last shot ends before the next subtitle, lines shortened to reading time (about 18.4 s of story), credit at size 40 on a band.
